scope: desktop-foundation 0.8 adoption for Textbutler's owner-facing copy paths (claude/ux-b-df08-20260926, plus the merge of current main 6498439): package.json/bun.lock pin the 0.8.0 release tarball; packages/textbutler/src/cli-style.ts delegates detectAudience and the symbol set to the kit; packages/textbutler/src/permission-copy.ts renders pre-prompt and recovery copy through the kit's renderPrePrompt/renderRecovery/settingsUrl/settingsPath while keeping Textbutler's two presets and its own formatting API; packages/textbutler/src/permission-prompt.ts keeps its own flow because iMessage setup names the Textbutler app as requester whichever terminal runs it; packages/textbutler/src/tui.ts asks the menu runner for --json inside the terminal session; menubar.test.ts reads the widened snapshot type through a v1 helper and pins the status test to an agent audience; scripts/build-textbutler.ts advances the PINNED_INPUTS build pin to 0.8.0 (added by this review).

rounds.design: Treat the kit delegation as a drop-in for the hand-rolled copies: identical audience precedence, identical symbol glyphs, identical permission sentences, and non-interactive output inside the terminal session.
blockers: The kit widened CompanionOptions.snapshot to SnapshotResult (v1 MenuItem[] | v2 MenuItemV2[] | MenuModel {items,mark,tooltip}). The menubar tests cast the result through a v1 helper with no runtime check; if any production snapshot path ever returned a MenuModel, every assertion would read the envelope instead of the items.

permission-copy.ts now asserts settingsUrl/settingsPath non-null with `!` and rebuilds the SETTINGS_URLS open-allowlist from the kit. If the kit returned null or different URLs for full-disk-access or automation, the pre-prompt would either crash or hand /usr/bin/open an unreviewed URL.

tui.ts forwards --json into handleCompanionCommand for start/install/stop inside the terminal session. If the kit still performed its interactive login-item notice under --json, the install path would keep waiting on stdin inside the session — the exact hang the fix claims to remove.

detectAudience is now the kit's implementation, not the local one; any drift in HRANESS_AUDIENCE precedence, agent markers, or the stderr-TTY fallback would silently change who sees human text versus JSON.

The merge with current main collided on the algal pin: main pins the reviewed ac68f096 revision while the branch base carried c5bd504. Resolving to the branch side would silently unpin a reviewed dependency.

The diff bumps package.json/bun.lock but never touches PINNED_INPUTS in scripts/build-textbutler.ts, which pins the same dependency at 0.7.0 — the build gate would reject the new manifest the moment the stale receipt stopped masking it.

rounds.design: Verify each candidate against the installed 0.8.0 artifact (dist/src/*.d.ts and *.js) and the textbutler tree, and resolve the lockfile conflict toward main's reviewed pin.
blockers: The cast is safe on every current path: companionOptions.snapshot (menubar.ts:258-281) always returns the MenuItem[] from snapshotItems, never a MenuModel; textbutler has no v2 mark/tooltip producer. The helper is test-only, and a future MenuModel producer would fail loudly (non-array has no .map), not silently.

The kit's KINDS table (permissions.js:18-19) binds full-disk-access and automation to the exact previous URLs — x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_AllFiles and ?Privacy_Automation — so the rebuilt SETTINGS_URLS allowlist is byte-identical and the `!` assertions cannot observe null for the bounded TextbutlerPermissionKind union.

Under --json, commands.js filters the flag, routes the result to the write callback, and calls prePrompt with audience 'agent'; permissions.js prePrompt for an agent writes one permission-notice JSON line and returns unattended-proceed without touching stdin — the install path can no longer hang the session.

Kit detectAudience preserves the exact precedence (HRANESS_AUDIENCE human/agent/quiet/off, exact-name AGENT_MARKERS, stderrIsTTY ?? process.stderr.isTTY, else quiet); verified against dist audience.js. Its one widening — trim().toLowerCase() on the override — accepts ' AGENT ' where the local copy required exact case.
The merge keeps main's reviewed algal pin ac68f096 and applies only the intended desktop-foundation 0.7.0 -> 0.8.0 bump; bun.lock was regenerated by bun install and agrees with package.json.

PINNED_INPUTS in scripts/build-textbutler.ts now carries the v0.8.0 tarball URL, exactly matching package.json; with it fixed, the post-rebind aggregate is fully green (746/746 package tests across 58 files, isolated-installation admission included).
acceptedNits: With --json the kit's agent-audience prePrompt still writes its one-line permission-notice JSON to process.stderr, which interleaves on the terminal hosting the session during install; cosmetic only, and strictly better than the stdin wait it replaced.
renderRecovery keeps `shown.next ?? need.next` where the kit always supplies next — the fallback is unreachable but harmless.
Kit detectAudience's trim/lowercase widening of HRANESS_AUDIENCE is accepted; all prior exact values behave identically.
APP_ENV = {} is belt-and-suspenders: requesterOf returns need.requester first, so the fixed env only matters if a future need drops the field.
rounds.verification: Kit copy traced line-by-line against the replaced literals: pre-prompt and recovery strings for both kinds and both states are byte-identical (confirmed by permission-copy.test.ts snapshots passing unchanged). Focused suites pass: permission-copy 18 snapshots plus cli-golden, menubar and tui-results — 62/62 green. Measured bun run check pre-rebind: 491/492, admission gate failing on predecessor hashes as documented; post-rebind it exposed the PINNED_INPUTS drift, and after that fix — and after absorbing #227's reviewed ack-overlap sources by a second merge of current main — the complete aggregate on the final tree is green (exit 0, 752/752 package tests across 58 files, isolated-installation admission included). Merge conflicts resolved to algal ac68f096 (main's reviewed pin) + desktop-foundation 0.8.0, and the receipt regenerated over the merged sources; bun.lock regenerated by bun install 1.3.14.

result: Ship. The adoption is a faithful delegation: identical audience rules, identical symbols (busy now reads the kit's progress glyph, same '↻'/'...' pair), byte-identical permission copy and Settings URLs, and a --json fix that removes a real stdin hang inside the terminal session. Review found one real omission — the build pin gate still named 0.7.0 — fixed in this change. Remaining deltas are documented nits.
